morphology.pattern_note: ber- 加在表示摔跤运动的名词 gusti 前，构成参与该活动的动词；词根首音 g 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 与对手抓抱、角力，力图将其摔倒；进行摔跤。
senses.en_definition: To grapple with an opponent in an attempt to throw them down; to wrestle.
senses.nuances: 通常是不及物动词，对手用 dengan 引出，如 bergusti dengan lawan。核心是抓抱与摔倒，不等于 menumbuk（挥拳击打），也不泛指所有打架行为。此处词根是运动义 gusti，与爪哇语贵族称号的同形词区分。[DBP：gusti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=gusti)

dual_scenarios.context: 体育新闻 / 训练汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Para peserta belajar bergusti di bawah bimbingan jurulatih yang berpengalaman.
dual_scenarios.zh: 参与者在经验丰富的教练指导下学习摔跤。
dual_scenarios.en: The participants learn to wrestle under the guidance of an experienced coach.

etymology.historical_story: The sporting word gusti has a Persian connection: historical dictionaries identify it with Persian kuštī, meaning wrestling. Malay then adds its own productive prefix ber- to express participation in the activity. This combines an inherited borrowing with ordinary Malay grammar. The identical spelling of a Javanese title should not be mistaken for the origin of the wrestling term. [Historical Malay-English dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/An_abridged_Malay-English_dictionary_%28romanized%29_%28IA_afu7967.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gusti 是摔跤，ber- 表示参与活动：ber-gusti，就是亲自上场摔跤。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 运动语境中属中性词。Kau、aku 适合熟悉的同辈；对长辈、教练或初次见面者，应采用姓名、职衔及 saya 等称呼。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于体育训练、比赛或双方同意的嬉闹描述。描述真实冲突时，只有确实发生抓抱角力才用 bergusti；泛指打架更常用 bergaduh。
